title: Treni za Yamanote Line mjini Tokyo ni ndefu sana, zaidi ya mara mbili ya metro ya Nagoya
label: Yamanote Line

text.In Tokyo, I rode a train called the Yama: Nikiwa Tokyo, nilipanda treni inayoitwa Yamanote Line.
Treni za Tokyo ni ndefu kweli.
text.If a Nagoya train is about 50 meters lon: Ikiwa treni ya Nagoya ina urefu wa takribani mita 50,
text.I felt a Tokyo train was about 3 times t: nilihisi treni ya Tokyo ilikuwa na urefu wa karibu mara tatu ya hapo.
Nilidhani ilikuwa na urefu wa takribani mita 150.
text.(I had AI look this part up.): (Niliomba AI itafute taarifa za sehemu hii.)
text.A Yamanote Line train has 11 cars. Each: Treni ya Yamanote Line ina mabehewa 11. Kila behewa lina urefu wa takribani mita 20, kwa hiyo jumla ni karibu mita 220.
text.The Nagoya subway (Higashiyama Line) has: Metro ya Nagoya (Higashiyama Line) ina mabehewa 6. Kila behewa lina urefu wa takribani mita 15, kwa hiyo jumla ni karibu mita 90.
text.So the Yamanote Line was more than 2 tim: Kwa hiyo, Yamanote Line ni zaidi ya mara mbili ya urefu wa metro ya Nagoya.
text.It was even longer than my \"about 150 m: Ilikuwa ndefu hata kuliko makadirio yangu ya “takribani mita 150.”
text.I thought such long trains might only be: Nilidhani huenda treni ndefu kama hizi zinapatikana Tokyo pekee.
text.Are these Tokyo trains the longest in th: Je, treni hizi za Tokyo ndizo ndefu zaidi duniani?
text.If you made a ranking of long trains, I: Nilijiuliza treni za JR kama Yamanote Line zingeshika nafasi gani kwenye orodha ya treni ndefu.
text.Even just in Tokyo, lines like the Tokai: Hata Tokyo pekee, njia kama Tokaido Line zina mabehewa 15 na urefu wa takribani mita 300.
text.The Shinkansen has 16 cars, about 400 me: Shinkansen ina mabehewa 16 na urefu wa takribani mita 400.
text.In the world, there are also long-distan: Duniani pia kuna treni za masafa marefu zenye zaidi ya mabehewa 20.
text.The Yamanote Line was not the longest in: Yamanote Line haikuwa treni ndefu zaidi duniani.
text.But a 220-meter train goes around and ar: Lakini kila baada ya dakika mbili au tatu, treni ya mita 220 huzunguka tena na tena.
text.That alone made me think that Tokyo real: Jambo hilo pekee lilinifanya nifikirie kuwa Tokyo inastaajabisha kweli.
